description: Multi-turn discussion behavior: fuzzy idea, user material intake, conflict, user correction, semantic checkpoint, resume, and handoff readiness.

conversation.content: 我想做个团队知识库助手，但还没想清楚。
Clarifies actors, scenarios, scope, and success criteria without jumping to implementation.
我有一份访谈笔记和截图，里面说搜索要支持权限隔离。
Records the supplied notes/screenshots as MAT-001/MAT-002 source_materials before using their claims.
等等，截图里的移动端不是第一版，先只做 Web。
Records the conflict and then the corrected non-goal/deferred scope.
Persists a complete semantic checkpoint and later resumes from canonical state.
Only writes handoff after latest checkpoint matches state and selected consumer is explicit.

good_transcript: 先把目标捋清：actors 是知识库管理员和团队成员；核心 scenarios 是上传资料、权限隔离搜索与结果追溯；success criteria 是无越权结果且答案能回到来源。
访谈笔记与截图已进入 source_materials，分别为 MAT-001 和 MAT-002。material coverage 显示两份资料均已检查，并由 source evidence 关联。
截图曾包含移动端范围，这是一个 conflict；按用户修正，当前只做 Web，移动端进入 non_goals。仍保留一个 soft unknown，由后续 owner 按 reopen condition 处理。
checkpoint 已保存完整语义快照；resume 将读取 canonical state，latest_checkpoint.snapshot_sha256 与当前状态一致。
在 selected consumer 明确后，runtime 从 checkpoint 派生 agent_requirement_contract，并用 discussion_snapshot_digest 绑定当前讨论；此时才允许进入 handoff review。
